issues.description: Problem statement requires SealSaloon to implement a method named checkOrderReady(), but the provided reference solution implements the same functionality under a different name (processOrders). This naming mismatch can mislead students and break tests expecting the specified method name.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename solution method processOrders() to checkOrderReady() and update the call in orderMeal() accordingly (or add a public checkOrderReady() wrapper that calls processOrders()).

issues.description: Problem statement specifies SealSaloon must have a final Stock attribute named stock (and states it must be static), but the solution declares it as static final and exposes it via a static getter (getStock()). If tests or expected usage treat stock as an instance field (as implied by the UML showing a SealSaloon->Stock association), this static exposure creates a conceptual/usage inconsistency.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts on whether stock is static or instance-level. If stock should be shared, update the UML/problem statement to clearly show stock is static and that getStock() is static; otherwise, make stock an instance final field and make getStock() an instance method.
